name: Saotome Yuu
source:
Yuu was born in a small, rural town, but moved to Tokyo to continue his studies.

He is a rather quiet person, and dislikes loud noises and arguments. He is the exact opposite of his father (a booming, hulking figure of a man, who loves being at the center of attention), who often teases Yuu about his housekeeping abilities.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=51275&p=492940#p492940]Lemma Soft[/url]]
